$comment: The extras of omx-phaser's declaration: what its descriptor, omx-phaser.descriptor.json, has no word for (docs/declaration-as-descriptor.md). The two are the folder's hand-written files; tools/gen.mjs generates the rest and writes the travels the descriptor's links resolve to. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's phaser kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Control order, the descriptor's, is append-only.
description: The console's phaser: identical all-pass sections swept in octaves by one oscillator, with feedback around the chain and a wet/dry mix.

console.$comment: The console has the phaser stage in its walk, with no contract yet, and draws no panel, chip or card for it today; racked as a plugin it is drawn by the generic plugin editor.
